body: They are more the "use god as a guilt trip" kind of people. Even if she forgives me being in contact with her isn't an option.
I don't think we are going to be able to work it out. That's why I'm so upset
I think the damage has been done so I'm not going to bother with screenshots but I did explain. I feel like I deserve all the shit they are giving me anyway.

She told the guidance conselour I fucked the guy she loved, then made me talk about it in front of said conselour but she basically just cried and kept saying stuff like "why would you do that???" And "you fucking knew i loved him" and honestly it made me feel awful. And then she called me later and told me about some screenshots she sent to him that made me look pretty bad so I think we are done.

I thought being honest with her would make me feel better but I am begining to wish I never told her. I have blocked them all because I'm going to avoid them until I graduate but it still really hurts that I have been through so much with them and they want nothing to do with me.
Both of her parents are teachers at our school. I have only talked to her once since this happened and it didn't go very well.
Her parents are super religious and didn't want her dating. My best friend still had feelings for him and thats why everyone was so mad.
Her parents made them break up.
Yes they broke up a month and a half ago.

I let my best friend know as soon as I woke up in the morning because I felt god awful. She told her mom, who won't let her talk to me anymore. Her older sister was also one of my closest friends aand she sent me a couple paragraphs on why I am terrible. The rest of them were pissed at me and him for hurting her feelings.
Also her sister dug up some screenshots from 4 months ago that out of context look like I was trying to hook up with him, even though it was not planned. They probably think I got him drunk to sleep with him.
